title: Aurora Beachy | Rosemary Beach House Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Aurora Beachy offers room for 8 guests in 2 bedrooms with a bonus bunk room. This quaint home has a balcony with views of Barrett Square and sandy beaches.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Welcome to Aurora Beachy!

This spacious and inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence comfortably accommodates up to 6 guests, making it the perfect getaway for families or small groups. In addition to the two luxurious king bedrooms, each with a private bathroom, the home also features a bonus bunk room with twin-over-twin beds.

Step into the bright and airy open floor plan, where you'll find a fully equipped kitchen ready for all your culinary adventures, a dining room that seats 6, and a convenient counter bar with 3 bar stools. The living space is designed for relaxation, with plenty of natural light and comfortable seating.

The oversized balcony is a highlight of this home, complete with a bistro table perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding with a view. Whether you're here for a short stay or an extended vacation, Aurora Beachy offers everything you need for a memorable beach retreat.

Inside the Unit:

Bunkroom: Located to the right of the foyer. It includes 2 twin bunk beds, a TV with internet-ready Blu-Ray player, cubbies for storage, and a small sitting area.

Living Area: Bright and airy with comfortable seating for 6, an entertainment area, and a TV.

Kitchen: Fully equipped with a microwave, dishwasher, Viking gas stove, refrigerator, blender, coffee pot, pots and pans, utensils, and a counter bar with 3 bar stools.

Dining Area: Features a formal dining table for 6.

Balcony: Oversized corner balcony with a 4-top bistro table, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the view.

Bedrooms & Bathrooms:

Master Bedroom: King bed, flat screen TV, walk-in closet, and a private bathroom with double vanity sinks and a walk-in glass shower.

Guest Bedroom: King bed, flat screen TV, walk-in closet, and a private bathroom with a single vanity and a tub/shower combo.

Community Amenities:

Underground garage parking.

Complimentary access to fitness and tennis facilities.

Two adult bikes included for your use.

Enjoy a walkable community with restaurants, coffee shops, retail stores, art galleries, a bank, post office, hair salon, fitness center, tennis center, 4 community pools, a chapel, and the beach, all connected by boardwalks and pathways.

Rental Policy:

During Spring Break and Summer, rentals are for 7 nights, from Saturday to Saturday.

Relax and enjoy your stay in this elegant and comfortable beach retreat!

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on building during January to as late as June 1
